title: Canadian federal trajectory map — stated plans vs pattern inference
disclaimer: Stated plans are sourced to primary government pages or on-record releases. Inferred trajectories are analytical hypotheses marked INFERENCE — not court findings. Verify before legal or media use.

stated_plans.label: Defence GDP ladder (2% → 4% → 5%)
stated_plans.near: Hit ~2% of GDP defence spend framing by FY 2025–26 acceleration; Budget 2025 multi-year defence envelope (~$81B class reporting).
stated_plans.mid: Carney-era rhetoric toward ~4% of GDP defence by ~2030 (CANSEC / industry framing).
stated_plans.long: NATO-aligned path toward 5% defence+security-related GDP by 2035 (PM release language, July 2026 NATO context).
stated_plans.watch: Promise-to-contract gap: announcements vs signed PSPC awards.

stated_plans.label: Arctic / Northern defence infrastructure
stated_plans.near: OTHR partnership with Australia (~$4.67B / 5y reporting); polar icebreakers (~$6.4B class); Arctic hubs/airfields in northern defence packages.
stated_plans.mid: Operational support hubs + airfield modernization; NORAD modernization continuity.
stated_plans.long: Sustained northern basing + surveillance lattice less dependent on ad-hoc US coverage.
stated_plans.watch: Indigenous consent, dual-use infrastructure, sole-source velocity.

stated_plans.label: Defence Industrial Strategy + Defence Investment Agency
stated_plans.near: DIA + DIS standup; faster procurement red-tape rhetoric; domestic content targets (industry messaging up to ~70% Canadian contract share).
stated_plans.mid: Scaled domestic production of munitions, sensors, platforms; CANSEC-class industrial mobilization.
stated_plans.long: Canada as reliable NATO industrial node, not only end-customer.
stated_plans.watch: Who captures industrial rents; sole-source vs competition balance.

stated_plans.label: Long-range strike + sovereign SATCOM
stated_plans.near: ~$800M Kongsberg JSM-class missile contract reporting; Telesat Lightspeed ESCP-P Arctic military SATCOM agreement-in-principle (multi-billion framing).
stated_plans.mid: Integration into future fighters; continuous Arctic satcom coverage claims.
stated_plans.long: Independent kill-chain + C2 resilience in contested Arctic.
stated_plans.watch: Integration timelines vs CAF readiness; cost growth.

stated_plans.label: Griffon fleet: pause life-extension → replacement pivot risk
stated_plans.near: GLLE ~$800M implementation paused (Jun 2026) for scope/cost/complexity + replacement-fleet planning (DND quote).
stated_plans.mid: Either refined GLLE restart or multi-billion replacement program definition.
stated_plans.long: Utility helicopter capability through 2030s+; ISS >$2B class sustainment context.
stated_plans.watch: Replacement dollar class unconfirmed; ATIP/PSPC awards needed.

inferred_trajectories.label: Municipal failure modes are national, not local
inferred_trajectories.claim: Auditor-general findings, commissions, and integrity records across 30 cities show the same operating pattern: lowball transit, optional competitive bidding, developer capital in land-use, and police budgets that expand while oversight shrinks — not isolated scandals.
inferred_trajectories.if_true_then: Provincial AG and federal infrastructure cost-sharing reforms become the real pressure point.
inferred_trajectories.falsifiable_by: Clean competitive transit delivery with on-time FOC and public cost tables in multiple cities.

inferred_trajectories.label: Procurement velocity distortion cluster persists
inferred_trajectories.claim: Pattern of accelerated sole-source or compressed competitions (OTHR, GlobalEye signals, short submarine framing, GLLE pause/replace) continues while spending ladders rise — increasing capture and audit risk.
inferred_trajectories.if_true_then: More multi-billion awards with thinner public competition paper trails; AG and NDDN heat rises late.
inferred_trajectories.falsifiable_by: Published competitive RFPs with multi-bidder timelines and full cost tables.

inferred_trajectories.label: Arctic becomes permanent budget gravity well
inferred_trajectories.claim: Northern defence + dual-use infrastructure absorbs a growing share of the multi-decade envelope; civilian northern development packaged as defence.
inferred_trajectories.if_true_then: Ring of Fire / critical minerals / roads narratives couple to defence industrial strategy.
inferred_trajectories.falsifiable_by: Budget lines that cleanly separate civilian northern spend from defence.

inferred_trajectories.label: GDP % targets outrun delivered capability
inferred_trajectories.claim: Political success metric becomes spending ratio and announcement cadence more than FOC dates and mission-ready squadrons.
inferred_trajectories.if_true_then: Repeat of past CAF readiness crises despite headline budgets.
inferred_trajectories.falsifiable_by: Public readiness metrics improving in lockstep with spend.

inferred_trajectories.label: Domestic content targets create preferred-vendor cartels
inferred_trajectories.claim: 70%-class Canadian content goals + DIA speed culture favor incumbents and PE-backed primes already networked to Ottawa.
inferred_trajectories.if_true_then: Lobbying intensity and revolving-door appointments increase around DIA.
inferred_trajectories.falsifiable_by: Transparent competitive win rates for new entrants.

inferred_trajectories.label: Defence sensors couple to domestic information control debates
inferred_trajectories.claim: Arctic OTHR, satcom, digital identity, and online-harms legislation form a wider sensing+narrative stack — not all malicious, but structurally centralizing.
inferred_trajectories.if_true_then: ATIP friction + cabinet confidence claims increase on dual-use systems.
inferred_trajectories.falsifiable_by: Clear statutory firewalls and independent oversight with teeth.
